correctness.rationale: For a rooted forest, Möbius inversion is local: Df(r)=f(r) and Df(v)=f(v)-f(p(v)). Thus Möbius convexity makes D^2f nonnegative at every nonroot. Hockey-stick domination supplies nonnegative gaps h_x; equal first moment and phi_1=sum over root Phi_r force all root gaps to zero, proving sufficiency, while testing Phi_x and plus/minus phi_1 proves necessity. For indicators, Df lies in {-1,0,1}, hence |D^2f|<=2 and TV<=2d_zeta. The three-chain witness attains equality.
